name: Timeless

overview: Timeless was a North American org founded in October 2022 by th3mfg and Chase. It grew out of the group behind Hour Zero and Kaizen. On a small budget it finished 2nd in OWCS NA Stage 1 2024 (losing only to Toronto Defiant), beat NRG Shock for North America's 3rd Esports World Cup seed, reverse-swept TSM from 0–3 for the FACEIT Season 2 title, and won Calling All Heroes titles in 2024 and 2026. Its time-themed social voice made it one of the most recognizable tier 2 brands, and its roster pipeline fed Dallas Fuel, Spacestation Gaming, Team Liquid, TSM and NTMR. The 2024 split over the EWC and several shutdowns cost it stability. Timeless came back in 2026.

name: TSM
